notes:
PlaneSite 1.6.3 - faster GeoTIFF writing:
- The render workers now compress the GeoTIFF's tiles in parallel; before, one writer did all the compressing and held rendering back (about 3 minutes of a 16-gigapixel job). The file is the same as before: same format, size and pixels, readable by GDAL, QGIS and ArcGIS.
- Includes the 1.6.2 colour changes.
